zh.title: 阿拉斯加航空擴大埃弗雷特佈局 春季增五成座位
zh.summary: 阿拉斯加航空擴大埃弗雷特佈局；春季座位增五成；斯諾霍米什郡旅客獲益
body: 根據Simple Flying於2026年9月25日發布的報導，阿拉斯加航空正式宣佈將大幅擴大其在華盛頓州埃弗雷特機場的營運佈局，具體計畫是在2027年春季前將該機場的座位總數增加百分之五十。
這項擴張計畫預計將直接惠及鄰近的斯諾霍米什郡居民，他們將獲得更快速的安檢通關體驗、更簡便的航廈進出流程，以及更多通往美國西岸各主要城市的航線選擇。
Simple Flying在報導中指出，阿拉斯加航空此次增加班次與座位的舉措，將進一步鞏固其在大西雅圖都會區北部地區的服務網絡深度。

en.title: Alaska Airlines Expands Everett Presence, Plans 50% Seat Increase by Spring
en.summary: Alaska Airlines expands Everett presence; plans 50% seat increase by spring; Snohomish County passengers benefit
body: According to Simple Flying on September 25, 2026, Alaska Airlines announced a major expansion of its operational presence at Everett's Paine Field, with a concrete plan to increase total seat capacity by 50% by spring 2027.

The expansion is expected to directly benefit residents of neighboring Snohomish County, who will gain faster security screening, simpler terminal access, and more flight options to major West Coast destinations.
Simple Flying noted that this increase in frequencies and seats will further strengthen Alaska Airlines' service network depth in the northern Seattle metropolitan area.
